Digital marketing

Social media marketing for a small business

Choose a channel and posting routine your team can sustain. Start with the questions customers already ask before visiting, booking or requesting a quote.

In this guide
Use the material you already havePlan for the replyReview demand

Use the material you already have

A bakery can show its ordering deadlines and cake sizes. A repair shop can explain how to describe a fault when requesting a quote. Get permission before including customers or identifiable projects.

Plan for the reply

Place opening hours and contact details where people can find them. Assign someone to respond to messages and give them a simple handoff when a question needs a quote, appointment or technical answer.

Review demand

Record which posts prompted relevant enquiries and what those customers needed. Use their questions to plan the next set of posts. An audience that asks a specific buying question may matter more than a post with wide reach.
